verdict.rationale: Bento's own marketing claims it can "tie sales and recurring revenue back to the email or flow that came before," which covers the conversion-attribution part of the story for campaigns and automations. Its unique-events docs add that revenue is counted without double-counting duplicate orders. Beyond that, the pack is thin: the broadcast API only mentions reviewing broadcast history, with no stated metrics. Missing for 10: documented open, click and unsubscribe reporting per campaign, per-automation-step metrics, time-series/over-time reporting views, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the analytics.
